subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu admit bot-authored group events by default when the app has the include-bot scope, or should bot admission require an explicit allowBots setting?
rationale: The PR preserves the currently reachable behavior once Feishu starts delivering bot-authored events, but accepting bot traffic plus loop suppression is an operator-visible product/default decision that code inspection cannot decide for maintainers.

options.title: Preserve Admission Default
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots as accept-all and rely on botLoopProtection plus allowBots=false/mentions for operators who need stricter behavior.

options.title: Require Explicit Bot Admission
options.body: Change the default to ignore bot-authored messages unless allowBots is true or mentions, reducing upgrade surprise at the cost of making bot-to-bot conversations opt-in.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Keep the PR open until a Feishu owner chooses the permanent bot-admission and loop-suppression policy.

recommendation.title: Preserve Admission Default
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots as accept-all and rely on botLoopProtection plus allowBots=false/mentions for operators who need stricter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on Feishu mention behavior and channel delivery semantics among the inspected paths.
